ابتعثتم (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثْتُمْ (ibtaʕaṯtum) /ib.ta.ʕaθ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اُبْتُعِثْتُمْ (ubtuʕiṯtum) /ub.tu.ʕiθ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
